title: Evidence receipt
description: Contract for archive/receipts/*.json, per the T15 plan (archive/sessions/2026-09-02-t15-receipts-and-migration-ledger-plan.md). Checked by scripts/check-receipts.mjs. A receipt is the file form of a claim like "312 tests pass" or "swept 40 capabilities" — produced once by the tool that ran the thing, never edited afterward. The file name (YYYY-MM-DD-<kind>-<topic>.json) is part of the contract; see README.md.

kind.description: What kind of evidence this is. Matches the filename's <kind> segment.

produced_by.description: The tool and the commit it ran at — so a reader can reproduce the receipt or tell it apart from a hand-written claim.

script.description: Repo-relative path to the script/command that produced this receipt.

commit.description: Git commit SHA the producing script ran at (short or full hex).

at.description: UTC timestamp the receipt was written, ISO 8601.

inputs.description: What was run against (a slug, a file list, a query, a manifest path, ...). Free-form — shape depends on kind.

summary.description: The counts a reader actually wants: passed/failed/total, findings count, rows swept, etc. Values are numbers, strings, or booleans — never a pre-formatted sentence.

topic.description: Optional restatement of the filename's <topic> segment for readability.

raw.description: Optional full output — inline, or a repo-relative path to it when too large to inline.
